worker_id.description: Unique identifier for this worker; if unset, generated from hostname.

server_url.description: HTTP(S) URL of the debusine server API endpoint.

worker_token.description: Authentication token shared with the debusine server.

worker_concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent work items the worker may handle.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

storage_root.description: Root directory for temporary build artifacts.

build_timeout.description: Maximum seconds allowed per work item before it is terminated.

no_proxy.description: Comma-separated list of hosts or suffixes exempt from proxying.

allowed_architectures.description: List of CPU architectures this worker may build for (e.g., ['amd64', 'arm64']).

allowed_series.description: List of Debian release series allowed (e.g., ['bookworm', 'bullseye']).

max_artifact_size_mb.description: Maximum size in MiB for each generated build artifact.

health_port.description: Port for the /healthz HTTP endpoint; set to 0 to disable.

metrics_port.description: Port for the /metrics Prometheus endpoint; set to 0 to disable.

allowed_signers.description: Space-separated list of GPG key fingerprints authorized to sign builds.

disable_signing.description: Whether to skip GPG signing of build artifacts (dangerous, mainly for testing).

worker_env.description: Extra environment variables for the worker process (KEY=VALUE pairs).
